subject: Your slider just got a 68-day upgrade
preview_text: A quiet thank you, plus something only long-term users see. Open to unlock.
body_paragraphs: Day 68. That's 68 days of listening without ads, without nags, without a single notification popping in mid-podcast. I wanted to say thank you—not through a popup, but through something that actually matters.

Long-term users like you get a backstage pass. No fanfare, no email blast. Just a simple toggle inside the app—one you've never seen before. It lets you set the slider's max range beyond 200%, all the way to 300%. Quietly. No one else knows about it.

Open Volume Booster Pro, go to Settings, and look for 'Extended Range'—it's hidden until you've been with us for 60 days. No announcement, no nags. Just a slider that goes further, because you've earned it.
Pull it open, push it past 200%, and see how it feels. P.S. This is a one-time thing—if you close the app, the toggle stays, but the invite doesn't repeat. It's yours now.
